updates.title: Project directory updated with fund-issuer details
updates.author: Luminary Technicals
updates.summary: The projects directory now identifies the stated issuer for JSET, AgroScan, Luminary Wishes, and Updates funding entries. The Luminary AI funding card was removed.

updates.title: Project audit links and availability labels clarified
updates.author: Luminary Technicals
updates.summary: Project listings distinguish available audit destinations from entries where an audit is not yet available, rather than presenting every project as having the same audit status.

updates.title: Luminary Technicals presents its five-core-organ structure
updates.author: Luminary Technicals
updates.summary: The organizational framework groups core work into Servers, Developers, Cares, Kits, and Federals, with distinct responsibilities across infrastructure, technology, education, integration, and civic initiatives.

updates.title: Luminary Developers focuses on software and emerging technology
updates.author: Luminary Developers
updates.summary: The Developers organ covers software engineering, AI systems, automation, open-source development, and emerging technology experiments.

updates.title: Luminary Servers covers infrastructure and digital operations
updates.author: Luminary Servers
updates.summary: The Servers organ describes the ecosystem's hosting, cloud, domain, networking, and infrastructure operations.

updates.title: Luminary Cares highlights education and community initiatives
updates.author: Luminary Cares
updates.summary: Luminary Cares focuses on technology education, mentorship, digital awareness, and community-oriented initiatives.

updates.title: Luminary Kits connects tools and collaborative projects
updates.author: Luminary Kits
updates.summary: Luminary Kits is the connective organ for reusable tools, integrations, APIs, and collaboration across the ecosystem.

updates.title: Luminary Federals covers civic engagement and public affairs
updates.author: Luminary Federals
updates.summary: The Federals organ covers public affairs, civic engagement, governance, policy research, and public-interest initiatives.
